cards.card_text: The LORD tells David to circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
cards.verse_text: So David inquired of the LORD, who answered, “Do not march straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
cards.snippet: …but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.

cards.card_text: The LORD tells David to attack the Philistines in front of the balsam trees.
cards.verse_text: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, because this will mean that the LORD has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
